name: Onakke Catacomb
description: An ancient catacomb or temple on Shandalar where the Chain Veil lay, partly crumbled after Liliana's battle with Garruk.

timeline.summary: At the catacomb Liliana kills a guarding angel, who warns her of the Onakke and that she is a vessel.
timeline.quote: She punctuated her words with a killing wave of raw necromantic power that flayed flesh from the angel's bones
